boats.name: Aurora
boats.description: Masthead sloop kept in the Stockholm archipelago. Sailed from May to October and laid up ashore for the winter.

boats.name: Petrel
boats.description: Twin-engine flybridge cruiser based on the Solent, used for weekend passages along the south coast.

boats.name: Tern
boats.description: Rigid inflatable used as Aurora's tender and for runs across the harbour.

entries.title: Sails bent on and inspected
entries.notes: Main and genoa bent on for the season. Checked every seam, the batten pockets and both leech lines before hoisting — nothing to report after the winter in the loft.

entries.title: Antifouling applied
entries.notes: Two coats below the waterline, a third along the waterline and on the leading edges of keel and rudder. Launched the following morning.

pictures.caption: On the cradle before the launch

entries.title: Rig tuned
entries.notes: Cap shrouds taken up one and a half turns each, lowers one turn. Mast straight under load on both tacks; turnbuckles locked with fresh split pins and taped.

entries.title: Raw-water impeller replaced
entries.notes: Weak cooling-water flow at the exhaust. One vane was cracked at the root; new impeller fitted with a smear of glycerine and a new cover gasket. Spare ordered.

pictures.caption: The old impeller — one vane cracked at the root

entries.title: Battery bank tested
entries.notes: Resting voltage 12.7 V on the house bank and 12.8 V on the start battery after a night off the charger. Terminals cleaned and greased, straps tight.

entries.title: Engine inspected
entries.notes: Mid-cruise look-over: belt, hoses, engine mounts and stern gland. A few drops at the gland while running, as it should be. Oil level unchanged since the last check.

entries.title: Primary winches serviced
entries.notes: Both primaries stripped, washed out and re-greased; pawls lightly oiled. One tired pawl spring replaced on the starboard winch.

entries.title: Mainsail batten pocket repaired
entries.notes: The top batten had worked through the end of its pocket. Hand-stitched a webbing patch over it — good for the rest of the season, but the sailmaker should redo it over the winter.

pictures.caption: Top batten pocket after the repair

entries.title: Hull and keel inspected at haul-out
entries.notes: Lifted for a mid-season scrub. No blisters, keel joint tight and dry, no play in the rudder bearings. Light weed along the waterline only.

pictures.caption: On the cradle after the pressure wash

entries.title: Shaft anode replaced
entries.notes: The old anode was a good half wasted. New zinc collar fitted with fresh bolts while the boat was out of the water.

entries.title: Bilge pump float switch replaced
entries.notes: The switch was sticking in the on position. New one wired in with heat-shrink connectors and tested with a bucket of water.

entries.title: Genoa sheets replaced
entries.notes: Both sheets swapped for 12 mm double braid, 14 m each. The old ones stay on board as spare mooring lines.

pictures.caption: New sheet on the port primary

entries.title: Rigging and sails inspected
entries.notes: Went aloft as far as the spreaders: shrouds, terminals and split pins all sound. Slight chafe on the genoa leech where it touches the spreader tip — spreader end taped. Mainsail stitching fine.

pictures.caption: Mainsail seams, seen from the boom

entries.title: Safety equipment inspected
entries.notes: Lifejackets inflated overnight and all held pressure; two gas cylinders are due for replacement next season. Flares in date until 2028, both extinguisher gauges in the green.

pictures.caption: Lifejacket, extinguisher and flares laid out for the check

entries.title: Engine serviced
entries.notes:
250-hour service. Engine oil changed (3.5 L of 15W-40), fuel pre-filter replaced and the system bled, gearbox oil level checked, air filter cleaned.

Ran the engine for 15 minutes afterwards: oil pressure and temperature normal, no leaks.

pictures.caption: New element in the fuel pre-filter
Impeller checked — due for replacement next season

entries.title: Oil filter replaced
entries.notes: New spin-on filter fitted with a film of oil on the gasket, hand-tight plus three quarters of a turn. Old filter drained and taken to the harbour's recycling point.

pictures.caption: Old filter out, new one ready

entries.title: Engine checked before the weekend passage
entries.notes: Oil level between the marks, coolant topped up by 0.2 L. Belt tension good, no leaks around the raw-water pump. Strainer cleared of eelgrass.

entries.title: Trim tab actuator repaired
entries.notes: Starboard tab was slow to respond. Corroded connector at the actuator cleaned and resealed; both tabs now travel evenly.

entries.title: Windlass serviced and inspected
entries.notes: Gypsy removed, cleaned and greased; clutch cone free. Foot switches and the chain counter tested, bitter end secured in the locker.

entries.title: Bow thruster anode replaced
entries.notes: Changed during a lift-and-hold over lunch. Thruster blades cleaned of barnacles while the boat was in the slings.

entries.title: Batteries and navigation lights inspected
entries.notes: All three batteries hold 12.7 V or better at rest. The stern light lens was cracked — replaced from the spares box. Shore-power lead and RCD tested.

entries.title: Port engine serviced
entries.notes: Annual service on the port engine: oil and filter, coolant strength checked, belt replaced. The starboard engine follows next month.

pictures.caption: Port engine with the covers off

entries.title: Fuel filters replaced
entries.notes: Primary separator elements changed on both engines and the bowls drained — a little water in the port bowl, none to starboard.

pictures.caption: Port separator with the new element

entries.title: Safety equipment inspected
entries.notes: Liferaft service is in date until next spring. Lifejacket lights tested, flares checked, fire blanket and extinguishers in place.

entries.title: Hull inspected after a scrub
entries.notes: Lift, pressure wash and relaunch. Antifouling still sound, no damage to the stern gear, trim tabs and anodes fine.

entries.title: Engines inspected
entries.notes: Checks before the run to Yarmouth: oil, coolant, belts and bilges on both engines. Weed cleared from the port raw-water strainer.

entries.title: Kill cord replaced
entries.notes: The old cord's clip had cracked. New coiled cord fitted, with a spare kept in the console locker.

entries.title: Tubes and hull inspected
entries.notes: Tubes still at pressure after 48 hours. Small scuff on the port bow patched with the repair kit; transom and drain plug fine.

entries.title: Outboard serviced
entries.notes: Gear oil and spark plugs changed, grease points done, cooling passages flushed with fresh water.
